title: The p-primary part of the Tate-Shafarevich group in ranks three to six: paper, data and certificates
description:
LaTeX source and PDF of the paper The p-primary part of the Tate-Shafarevich group in ranks three to six, with the data, programs and Lean 4 files behind it.

The paper proves Sha(E/Q)[p] = 0 for the rank-four curve 234446a1 at every prime 5 ≤ p < 1000 except 337, for the rank-five and rank-six curves of Elkies and Watkins at small primes, and for the 494 isogeny classes of rank three with conductor between 30,000 and 100,000 at every good ordinary prime 5 ≤ p < 100. It does not prove the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture or the finiteness of Sha for any curve of rank at least two.
